facts.en: Completed an information systems diploma at Fictional Sandpiper Institute in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构矶鹬学院完成信息系统文凭课程。

facts.en: A 2024 classroom module included a fictional incident tabletop exercise; completion was assessed internally, not by a certification body.
facts.zh: 2024 年课堂模块包含虚构事件桌面演练；完成情况由内部评估，非认证机构评估。

facts.en: In that exercise, sorted 28 instructor-provided incident cards into a draft escalation sheet.
facts.zh: 在该演练中，将教师提供的 28 张事件卡整理到草拟的上报表中。

facts.en: Presented the sheet with 3 classmates; the instructor decided whether the proposed escalation was appropriate.
facts.zh: 与 3 名同学共同展示该表；上报建议是否恰当由教师判断。

facts.en: The exercise involved no real systems, live investigation or professional security certification.
facts.zh: 该演练不涉及真实系统、实际调查或专业安全认证。

facts.en: Training administration assistant at Fictional Copper Kite Services, 2024-09 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-09 至 2026-08 在虚构铜风筝服务机构任培训行政助理。

facts.en: Scheduled internal training sessions and maintained attendance and reminder logs.
facts.zh: 安排内部培训场次并维护出席及提醒日志。

facts.en: Sent approved course instructions and directed technical questions to trainers.
facts.zh: 发送获批课程说明，并将技术问题转交培训师。

facts.en: Worked with a training coordinator to consolidate attendance logs for 9 sessions during 2025-05 to 2025-07.
facts.zh: 2025-05 至 2025-07 与培训协调员合作汇总 9 场培训的出席日志。

facts.en: Reconciled 112 attendance entries against sign-in sheets, identifying 7 duplicate entries for coordinator approval.
facts.zh: 依据签到表核对 112 条出席记录，识别 7 条重复记录供协调员审批。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet lookup formulas, calendar invitations and document revision tracking.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格查找公式、日历邀请及文档修订跟踪。

facts.en: Drafted a quiz reminder template in 2026-01; no evidence of organization-wide adoption is supplied.
facts.zh: 2026-01 起草测验提醒模板；未提供组织范围内采用的证据。

facts.en: A short first-aid awareness session in 2025 was attendance-only and is not a claimed qualification.
facts.zh: 2025 年一次简短急救意识活动仅记录出席，不作为资格声明。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Board Game Circle during 2023-06 to 2023-11 on evenings while studying.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2023-11 学习期间晚间在虚构桌游社做志愿者。

facts.en: Prepared printed game rules for that club, separate from paid training work.
facts.zh: 为该社团准备纸质游戏规则，与有薪培训工作分开。
爱好拼装木制益智玩具。

facts.en: A draft profile calls the classroom exercise a security certification; no issued credential supports that phrase.
facts.zh: 档案草稿将课堂演练称为安全认证；无颁发的资格证明支持该表述。

facts.en: No professional incident-response employment or security approval authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录专业事件响应工作或安全审批权限。
